messages:
Sophie L: Heads-up — planning to ship console v2.11 to prod tonight at 23:30 PT. Need someone to own smoke checks + CDN/cache invalidation. Will do canary 10% at 23:10 then full at 23:30. Who's available? :clock11:

Ben O: I can do CDN purge and smoke. I'll handle the purge right after full rollout and run the health checks. Ping me 10m beforehand.

Alex R: Quick q — are we doing a cache-busting param on the bundle URLs or a CDN invalidation? Prefer invalidation but need to know for rollback plan.

Sophie L: Good point. We should invalidate the asset keys so older clients don't get mixed bundles. Ben, can you run invalidation for `/assets/console/*` after the full rollout? Also watch the asset version header: `X-Console-Version`.

Ben O: Yep. I'll invalidate the edge and then sweep the regional caches. Steps I use:
```bash
# Invalidate CloudEdge distribution
ci tools cdn invalidate --pattern '/assets/console/*' --wait
# then check status
ci tools cdn status --id $DISTRIBUTION_ID
```
I'll post the status URL here once started.

Jess K: For rollback readiness: make sure the DB migration in this deploy is backward compatible. If we need to revert the UI only, we can point traffic to blue instance and revert the asset pointer. I've left a canary flag so we can flip quickly.

Alex R: Also adding: run the smoke suite against /health, login flow, and the bundle hash check. I have a small script:
```js
// smoke-check.js
fetch('/health').then(... )
fetch('/login').then(... )
fetch('/static/js/main.js').then(r=>r.headers.get('X-Console-Version'))
```
I'll run this at 23:35 and report.

Deploy Bot: Deploy started by @sophie · build 2026.02.19-872

Ben O: Invalidation kicked off: https://console.cdn/status/invalidations/abc123

Sophie L: Thanks — @Ben O please confirm when invalidation completes. @Alex R @Jess K please post quick pass/fail for smoke checks. If no blockers by 23:50 PT we'll close the rollout.

Jess K: Smoke pass on canary flows, DB checks OK. No schema changes that block UI revert. :white_check_mark:

Alex R: Smoke pass for login + bundle header shows `v2.11`.

Ben O: Invalidation complete and edge TTL bumped. CDN status: OK. :rocket:

Sophie L: Awesome. I'll update release notes and close the thread after the post-rollout monitoring window (30m). If anything pops, add a direct DM to me and @jess.

Ben O: Noted. I'll keep an eye on 500s and asset 404s. Posting logs if anything looks off.

Deploy Bot: Canary 10% -> success. Full rollout -> success.

Sophie L: Great work everyone — thanks for the quick turnaround. :tada:
